meta.note: Design System v2 (ADR-014, proposed). Colours are the v2 semantic tokens mapped to primitives in docs/10-design-system/token-mapping.md.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-width tinted section bands (alternate sections, news band, partner strip).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header bar, footer, auth form side.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Nested surfaces: closed accordion items, table header, hovered rows, chips at rest.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input, select and textarea fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between and around content (not a control boundary).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons. Meets 3:1.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Accent-framed surfaces: dialog edge, selected card, header hairline.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Ledes, meta rows, captions, helper text.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only (never information the reader needs).

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on the accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active nav marker, selected state.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, active nav text, accent icons on any surface.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill: selected chip, open accordion item, active tab, success alert.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Decorative marks and large display numerals (24px+) only: motif dots, stat figures, glows. Never body text.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Deep brand fill: secondary filled button, brand panel.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on the brand fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success alert and pill fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons; "closes soon".

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert and pill fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error borders, error icons.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert and pill fill.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill.

tokens.name: on-danger-fill
tokens.usage: Label on the destructive fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info alert and pill fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 2px offset.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: White quiet zone behind QR codes in both themes (scanners need light around the code). Nowhere else.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog and bottom-sheet backdrop. In code: color-mix() of --c-000000 / --c-123b35, never a literal.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Home hero headline only, one per site. Fluid 40px (360 viewport) to 72px (1440): clamp(2.5rem, 1.833rem + 2.963vw, 4.5rem). Line height 1.25 Arabic / 1.1 English. Max 18ch.

styles.name: t-h1
styles.usage: Page and event titles. Fluid 32px to 56px: clamp(2rem, 1.5rem + 2.222vw, 3.5rem). Max 24ch.

styles.name: t-h2
styles.usage: Section titles, preceded by the signal dots. Fluid 28px to 44px: clamp(1.75rem, 1.417rem + 1.481vw, 2.75rem).

styles.name: t-h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections, dialog and result titles. Fluid 20px to 24px.

styles.name: t-stat
styles.usage: Key figures with tabular numerals, in --signal. Fluid 36px to 56px. Real data only.

styles.name: t-lede
styles.usage: Hero and section ledes in --text-muted, max 60ch. Fluid 17px to 20px.
styles.sample: ورش عمل ولقاءات تقنية مفتوحة للجميع، حضورياً وعن بُعد.

styles.name: t-body
styles.usage: Paragraphs. Line height 1.8 Arabic / 1.65 English. Max 70ch. Never smaller on phones.
styles.sample: نلتقي كل شهر لنتعلّم معاً ونبني مشاريع حقيقية.

styles.name: t-body-sm
styles.usage: Meta rows, helper text, footer, breadcrumb.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Form labels, md button labels, navigation.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Counts, timestamps, the certificate kind line.

styles.name: t-badge
styles.usage: Badges and pills only. The smallest text on the site.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip gaps, label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Meta row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter, compact card padding, form row gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap (tablet), card padding (phone).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap (desktop), field-to-field gap, tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section header to content, dialog padding (desktop), laptop gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero inner padding (phone), band padding (phone).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Detail grid gap; band padding (tablet).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on phones; band padding (desktop).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on tablets.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on desktop. The section gap is fluid: clamp(4rem, 2.833rem + 5.185vw, 7.5rem).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tooltip, image inside a small card.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, textarea, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Accordion items, list cards, menus, the image inside a card (24 - 8 padding).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the floating header, the hero card.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Section bands, the auth brand panel, the footer top corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Every button, pill, badge, chip, avatar and the segmented toggle.

shadow.note: Tone and hairlines first; shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: Hovered interactive cards only. Cards at rest have no shadow (border only).

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, menus, the floating header after scrolling.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: Toasts (above dialogs).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Default page content width; padding = the gutter (16 / 24 / 32px).

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Inner width of full-bleed bands and the floating header.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Forms, the join flow, the certificate page.

tokens.name: container-reading
tokens.usage: Article body (about 68ch).

tokens.name: container-tight
tokens.usage: The auth form column and small dialogs.

tokens.name: side-panel
tokens.usage: The event page side panel from 1024px.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky filter bar and the mobile action bar.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The floating header.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog, sheet and scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast region.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: The skip link when focused.
